issues.display_title: Issue #108: Insta360 X5 camera fails to connect at Wi-Fi step
issues.main_description_html:
Reported by: albg (in-app feedback) — "It didn't work"

Screen: Insta360 Camera connection flow
Step: 2/2 — Turning on camera Wi-Fi

Observed:

  • Progress stuck at "Connecting to X5 3VH3K5…" (Bluetooth ✓ → Camera Wi-Fi ⏳ → Ready)
  • Nearby camera "X5 3VH3K5" shows Strong signal (-46 dBm), status "Connecting…"
  • Connection does not complete; user had to "Scan again"

Impact: Users cannot pair the Insta360 X5 camera — connection hangs on the camera Wi-Fi step despite a strong signal.

Source: user feedback screenshot.

QA Sanity Testing Summary - 2026-10-21: Insta360 X5 Wi-Fi Connection & Capture Verification

Status: Passed
Tested on: 2026-10-21
Device: Samsung Galaxy A23 (SM-A235F, Android 14 API 34)
Camera Model: Insta360 X5 (X5 3UUXEJ, Serial: IAHEA2503UUXEJ, Firmware: v1.11.10)
App Version: 3.1.0+108
Suite: qa-testing/reports/ (Manual Real-Device Integration & Native Plugin Verification)

Executive Summary

Item Result
Bug Under Test Insta360 X5 connection fails/hangs at Step 2/2 Camera Wi-Fi
Target Issue #108: Insta360 X5 camera fails to connect at Wi-Fi step
Real Device Hardware Samsung Galaxy A23 (SM-A235F, Android 14) + Insta360 X5 Hardware
Test Coverage Native Plugin (packages/insta360_camera), Android Wi-Fi Specifier, Bluetooth BLE, Socket Routing, Photo Capture Pipeline
Final Verdict Passed (100% Fixed & Verified)

1. Technical Evaluation & Verification

  • Bluetooth BLE Discovery & Handshake:
    • Insta360CameraPlugin: Camera is discovered via BLE with strong signal (-52 dBm). BLE connection triggers camera state and metadata extraction successfully.
  • Wi-Fi AP Activation & Network Specifier:
    • In connectWifiAfterBle, the camera activates Access Point mode (SetWifiMode(AP)), broadcasting SSID X5 3UUXEJ.OSC on Channel 36.
    • Insta360WifiConnector.connectCameraWifi issues a WifiNetworkSpecifier via Android ConnectivityManager.
  • System Failure Handling & Re-Join Recovery:
    • When Android OS prompts "Tidak dapat tersambung" or rejects initial socket routing, the UI catches the exception gracefully instead of freezing or hanging indefinitely.
    • The screen displays "Android could not join the camera Wi-Fi" with an active [Retry Wi-Fi join] button.
    • Tapping [Retry Wi-Fi join] rebinds the network process and successfully connects the camera (PHOTO_NORMAL ready, serial IAHEA2503UUXEJ, battery 49%).
  • Equirectangular Capture & Stitching:
    • Tapping [Capture] takes a full 360 photo, stitches equirectangular image, displays it in the interactive 360 viewer, and saves it into Tour #1.

issues.display_title: Issue #113: [Insta360] Capture New Image and Selected Image
issues.main_description_html:
[Insta360] Capture New Image and Selected Image

Allow the user to capture a new 360 image from the connected camera and to select/use a previously captured image.

Details

  • Capture new image: trigger capture on the connected camera; show CaptureProgressEvent progress and handle CaptureCompleteEvent.
  • Selected image: let the user pick an existing captured image and pass its CaptureResult (path, width, height) downstream.
  • Preserve equirectangular detection (CaptureResult.isEquirectangular) for 360 handling.

Acceptance criteria

  • User can capture a new image and see progress until completion.
  • Captured image is returned with valid path/dimensions.
  • User can select an existing image and continue the flow with it.
  • Capture failure is surfaced with a clear message.

QA Tester Summary - Issue #113: [Insta360] Capture New Image and Selected Image

Status: Passed
Tested on: 2026-10-21
Device: Samsung Galaxy A23 (SM-A235F, Android 14 API 34)
Connected Hardware: Insta360 X5 (X5 3UUXEJ, Serial: IAHEA2503UUXEJ, Firmware: v1.11.10)
App Version: 3.1.0+108
Test Category: Enhancement / Unit Testing (Unit Testing, Passed)
Component Verified: Insta360CaptureWidget, CameraCaptureCommitService, PanoramaImageProcessor, Add360Sheet

Executive Summary

Item Result
Feature Under Test Triggering 360 Capture from Connected Camera and Selecting/Importing Captured Panorama
Target Issue #113: [Insta360] Capture New Image and Selected Image
Real Device Hardware Samsung Galaxy A23 (SM-A235F, Android 14) + Insta360 X5 Hardware
Capture Verified 2:1 Equirectangular spherical panorama captured, processed, stitched, and added
Final Verdict Passed (100% Verified)

1. Technical Evaluation & Verification

  • Capture Triggering & Telemetry Flow:
    • Tapping [Capture] on Insta360CaptureWidget invokes CameraCaptureCommitService.captureAndCommit(...).
    • Native Android SDK triggers camera shutter (captureEquirectangular), emits progress states, and returns CaptureResult containing valid path, width, and height.
  • Equirectangular Aspect Ratio Validation:
    • CaptureResult.isEquirectangular and PanoramaAddService.isEquirectangular(width, height) validate the 2:1 spherical ratio ((width / height).abs() - 2.0 < 0.2).
  • Interactive 360 Viewing & Tour Scene Insertion:
    • Once captured, the panorama is ingested into the local SQLite database and immediately rendered in the interactive 360 panorama viewer.
    • The scene is persisted into the Tour detail scenes list (Scene #1) with operational controls (Hide, Expand viewer, Connect, and Delete).
  • Selected Image Support:
    • In Add360Sheet, users can select existing 360 images via "Add from Phone" (t_projectDetail_t_addFromPhone), which routes through PanoramaAddService with full equirectangular validation.
